**Assessment:** rejected.

The new post's broad assertion that mainstream media lies to the public closely echoes [T4-009626](#T4-009626), which shouts "LIES. MSM LIES," and [T4-009494](#T4-009494), which blames "continual lies, cover-ups" for lost trust. It also overlaps with [T4-008391](#T4-008391)'s characterization of American mainstream media as "a national disgrace" and with [T4-002864](#T4-002864), which accuses mass media of deflecting attention from #DNCleak, though the latter ties the claim to a specific issue and partisan dependency. The new post is more generic and issue-agnostic than these, and differs from [T4-006638](#T4-006638), which merely asks whether the media is "an enemy of the American people" rather than asserting deception.
